pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026-1287 — inference-service p95 latency > 2.0s in us-west-2. Trigger: alert 'inference-p95-latency-high'. Affected customers: acme-corp (prod). Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-1287
incident-bot: Automatic page to oncall: @Alice M (primary). Escalation timer: 10m.
Alice M: ack. I'm taking it. Starting a quick triage. @Bob R you're shadowed if available.
Bob R: on channel. I can help with logs and instance health. Give me a minute to pull metrics.
Alice M: seeing p95 jump ~2.4s, p99 ~3.8s. Pod restarts look low. GPU util at 88% across the fleet. Queue length up ~2.2x.
Dinesh K: could be KV cache misses after the recent rollout. Which model variant is affected?
Alice M: model: rwd-open-7b-quant. Variant = v2026-03-10. Will check cache hit ratio.
Alice M: runbook: https://runbooks.internal.redwood/inference-latency -> step 1 check batching, step 3 scale if util>80%
Carla S: adding context: production canary rolled v2026-03-10 ~02:10 UTC. No config changes since. If cache cold maybe due to restart windows.
Alice M: temp mitigation: bumping dedicated pool by +2 GPUs (scale command):
```
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool inference-dedicated-usw2 --add-gpus 2
```
Alice M: executed. Waiting for nodes to register.
incident-bot: PD note: Alice M acked at 1800004350. Escalation timer paused.
Bob R: nodes are coming up, healthchecks passing, new pods scheduling.
Alice M: p95 back to ~1.6s after scale, p99 ~2.5s. Good sign. Monitoring for 10m.
Alice M: quick ask — I have a 15m meeting in ~10m. Can someone take ownership if still ongoing?
Carla S: I can take over. Taking PD ownership now. Carla S (ack).
pagerduty-bot: Incident reassigned: owner changed to Carla S.
Carla S: picking up. Current status: scaled +2 GPUs, p95 improved to 1.4s, but a small percentage of requests still see >2s. Investigating KV cache hit ratio and model shard distribution.
Emma L: I'm pulling KV cache metrics. Hit ratio dipped to 47% at spike start, now at 71%.
Carla S: good. I'm going to warm caches on a subset of replicas to reduce cold starts (runbook step 5). Running warm script now.
```
kubectl exec -it deploy/inference-warm -- ./scripts/warm_cache.sh --model rwd-open-7b-quant --concurrency 20
```
Carla S: warmers started. ETA ~6m.
Bob R: FYI no errors in logs, just increased latency. No customer errors seen in app logs.
Carla S: after warmers, p95 is 1.1s, p99 1.8s. Looks resolved for now. I'll keep monitoring for 20m and then close the PD incident if stable.
Alice M: thanks Carla and team. I'll file a follow-up to check whether rollout contributed.
Carla S: marking incident as 'Mitigated'. Customer impact: degraded latency for acme-corp (prod) for ~12 minutes. No failed requests or data loss.
Dinesh K: note to postmortem: evaluate cache prime during canary and consider pre-warming on deploy.
Carla S: closing PD incident in 20m if stable. I'll open a runbook improvement ticket.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1287 mitigated at 1800004670. Remember to run postmortem template: https://templates.internal/postmortems
Emma L: thanks all. :thumbsup:
Carla S: filing follow-up: https://jira.internal/browse/INF-4521 — brief summary attached.
Alice M: leaving channel, great job. :clap:
